text: Week-by-week history page: championship, Grand Final, top 2, minor premier and finals chances for each week of 13 past seasons, with movement and a reliability note.
Round-by-round history page: every team's premiership, Grand Final, top 4, top 8 and finals chances after each round of 14 past seasons, with movement and a reliability note.

Week-by-week history page: every team's title, conference, division, top-seed and playoff chance for each week of 14 past seasons, with 1- and 4-week movement and a reliability note (also NHL, 10 seasons).
Back-test now uses one league-wide checkpoint date (the old split gave wrong game counts for many teams); 20-game playoff score is 0.428 over 2021-25, not the 0.415 shown before.
Winner trends page: what national champions, finalists and playoff teams had in common (2014 onward).
Havoc rate (sacks, tackles for loss, pass breakups, turnovers) on team pages, plus havoc plays per defender on the players page.
Hustle stats (deflections, loose balls, box-outs) and Synergy play-type stats for teams and players, from 2015-16.
Preseason playoff and conference probabilities are less overconfident (tested over 14 seasons); fades out by game 16.
Fixed extra games showing in 2025-26 regular-season game logs (finals and play-in games now kept separate).
College football (FBS) advanced team and player stats and 12 seasons of history.
Assist-to-turnover ratio and assists as a share of made field goals for teams, players and game logs (also NBL).
Game logs now use official full-game team totals, backfilled for all 15 seasons.
Availability page: injured players' points value and games affected, now feeding the season simulation.
